transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Harry! The dinner is in forty minutes and I've got nothing to wear! You said you'd drop the robes at the cleaners three days ago! Hermione's parents are Muggles — I can't just Transfigure something, Hermione will murder me! What were you even doing?!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Oh, Ron, I'm so sorry! I completely forgot. I was... I was working on a new tracking spell for work and lost track of time. I'll Apparate to the cleaners right now!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Apparate? It's a Muggle cleaners, Harry! They don't have a Floo connection! And it's probably closed by now! Blimey, I'm going to have to wear my old Chudley Cannons jumper, aren't I? Hermione's going to give me that look all night.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: You're right, I wasn't thinking. Listen, I'll come up with something. Let's borrow something from my trunk. I've got a few extra robes... we can adjust them with a couple of well-placed Stupefy and Finite Incantatem charms. It'll be like a quick Transfiguration, just... not quite as permanent.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Are you mad? Last time you tried that, my trousers turned into a pair of angry garden gnomes! We're not doing any magic near my clothes, not when we're meeting Hermione's parents. They already think we're a bit odd!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Ron, I know, I know. This is all my fault. Hang on, what about this? I've got a Time-Turner. We can go back and fix this, but we need to move fast. I can take you to get the robes, but then we have to make it back in time. It's a bit of a risk, but... it's the best chance we've got.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: A Time-Turner? You still have one of those? I thought the Ministry confiscated them all after... well, you know. But fine, fine! Just don't mess with the timeline, Harry. I don't want to accidentally erase myself from existence because you forgot my dry cleaning.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Ron, I'm not going to mess with anything. We just need to go back, get the robes, and come back. It'll be fine. C'mon, we need to get moving. I'll take us to the cleaners and we'll apparate straight back here. It'll be like we never left. Let's go, before we're late!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Alright, alright! But if we end up in the middle of the Battle of Hogwarts again, I'm blaming you. And you're explaining to Hermione why we're late.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Trust me, Ron, I don't want to end up in the middle of anything except your dinner. I'll be quick, I promise. Here we go... one, two, three! Expecto Patronum! ...And back again. There, we made it. Now, where did we leave the robes? Let's get them and get out of here!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Wait, Harry, wait! Did you just use a Patronus to activate a Time-Turner? That's not how they work! And why is it so dark in here? This isn't the cleaners, this is... is that the Shrieking Shack?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Oh no... I must have done something wrong. It's okay, Ron, we can still fix this. Maybe... maybe we can apparate to the cleaners from here. Or... or we can find a way to borrow some clothes from someone in the past. We'll just have to be careful not to change anything important. Help me think, Ron!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Change anything important? Harry, we're in the past! We're already changing things just by being here! And I'm still in my pajamas! This is a disaster! Hermione is going to kill us both!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Ron, calm down! We'll figure this out. I promise. Let's just... let's just look for a way to get back to our time. There's got to be a way. Maybe we can use the Time-Turner to go back further, to a time when we're not in danger of missing the dinner. Or... or we can find a way to send a message to our past selves. We're smart, we can do this.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Smart? We're Aurors-in-training, not Unspeakables! Look, just... just point that thing at the sun or something and get us home. I'll wear the Cannons jumper. I don't care anymore. I just want to be back in our flat before Hermione sends out a search party.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: You're right, Ron. We should get back as soon as possible. Let's try the Time-Turner again, but this time... this time we'll be more careful. I'll count to three, and then we'll go. One... two... three! ...And back! ...Where are we? This doesn't look like our flat... or the cleaners... Oh no, Ron, we've done it again. But at least we're outside this time. Let's find a safe place to apparate. We can still make it to the dinner if we move quickly.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Outside? Harry, we're in the middle of Diagon Alley! And it's... it's the day of the Quidditch World Cup! I recognize that banner! We're years off! We're going to miss dinner by about four years!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Four years? Ron, that's... that's impossible. No, no, we can't have done that. We just need to find a way to get back. Let's try the Time-Turner again, but... but we need to be more precise. Maybe we can find a landmark to anchor our return. Or... or we can ask someone for help. There's got to be a wizard around who can help us. We're not alone in this, Ron. We'll get back, I promise.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Ask someone? Harry, we can't just walk up to a random wizard and say, "Excuse me, we've mucked up time travel, can you point us to the nearest temporal vortex?" They'll think we're nutters! And we are! We're completely nutters!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Ron, we can't just stand here. We need to act. Look, there's a clock tower. Maybe we can use that as a marker to get back to our own time. Or... or we can find a way to send a message to our past selves. I remember reading about a spell that can send messages across time. It's called a... a... a Temporal Textus! Yes, that's it! We just need to find a piece of parchment and... Oh, wait, no, that's not right. It's just that feeling of... of knowing something, but not quite being able to remember it. We'll figure this out, Ron. We're not going to let Hermione down, not after all the times she's stood by us. We'll get back, I swear.

Openness.behavioral_evidence: Proposes creative, unconventional solutions like using a Time-Turner and a 'Temporal Textus' spell, showing high imagination and willingness to experiment.

Conscientiousness.behavioral_evidence: Forgot about the dry cleaning for three days and causes a major time-travel mishap, demonstrating poor planning and follow-through.

Extraversion.behavioral_evidence: Takes charge, speaks decisively ('We'll figure this out'), and suggests asking others for help, showing assertiveness and social engagement.

Agreeableness.behavioral_evidence: Apologizes sincerely ('I'm so sorry! This is all my fault') but repeatedly makes impulsive decisions that escalate the problem for Ron.

Neuroticism.behavioral_evidence: Remains calm and optimistic despite major setbacks ('We'll get back, I promise'), showing low emotional volatility and anxiety.
